q: How do I ask for an appointment?
a: Use our booking page, or call us. We reply within 1 business day to confirm your time.

q: Can I see what things cost?
a: Yes. Our [price list](/prices/) shows our usual prices and the date we last checked them.
Yes, before treatment that costs more than 500 pounds. You can also [ask for one](/estimates/) for smaller jobs.

q: What if my pet is ill at night?
a: Call our out of hours number. A vet will call you back. See our [out of hours page](/out-of-hours/).

q: What should I bring to a visit?
a: Bring your pet in a carrier or on a lead, and any medicine they take. We never ask about your pet's health on this website.
Ask us before treatment. We can talk about options and about our [pet health plans](/pet-health-plans/).

q: Why is the prescription fee different from the medicine cost?
a: The fee covers the vet's time to check your pet and write the prescription. The medicine is priced separately.
